summary: The Wisconsin Council of Religious & Independent Schools (WCRIS) urges the FCC to preserve E-Rate funding and availability for private schools, emphasizing the program's cost-effectiveness and essential role in providing connectivity and educational support. WCRIS also expresses concerns about potential federal mandates on screen-time and content monitoring, advocating for flexibility in implementing internet safety measures tailored to private schools' unique missions and community values. The comments from a private school advocacy group urge the FCC to retain flexibility in implementing internet safety measures and to avoid imposing rigid requirements on schools, particularly those with limited administrative capacity. They also request that the Commission consider the operational realities of private schools when developing final rules.
